episodes.name: Peter, Peter, Caviar Eater
episodes.overview: Lois' aunt dies and leaves her mansion to the Griffins.

episodes.name: Holy Crap
episodes.overview: Peter's very religious father comes to live with the family after he is forced to retire from his lifelong job at the Mill.

episodes.name: Da Boom
episodes.overview: Paranoid about Y2K, Peter herds the family into the basement for protection.

episodes.name: Brian in Love
episodes.overview: A therapist tells Brian his carpet-wetting is the result of his repressed feelings for Lois.

episodes.name: Love Thy Trophy
episodes.overview: The Griffins and their neighbors build a festival float; waitress Meg schemes to get bigger tips.

episodes.name: Death Is a Bitch
episodes.overview: When Peter tries to get out of paying a doctors bill by faking his own death, he is visited by Death himself, who wants to take Peter away. After Death twists his ankle while chasing Peter, everyone on Earth becomes immortal while death is incapacitated.

episodes.name: The King Is Dead
episodes.overview: When Lois become the director of the Quahog Players production of "The King and I" Peter wants a part. He finds himself in the Producer's Chair and starts to make some "artistic changes" to the script that involve scantily-clad women and cyborgs.

episodes.name: I Am Peter, Hear Me Roar
episodes.overview: Forced to go to a women's retreat for telling sexist jokes at work, Peter resists the idea at first. After two weeks, however, Peter becomes a sensitive male. No one likes the new Peter, especially Lois. While attending a charity dinner, Lois does something that snaps Peter out of his feminine phase.

episodes.name: If I'm Dyin', I'm Lyin'
episodes.overview: Peter makes Chris pretend he's dying, in order to save a television program.

episodes.name: Running Mates
episodes.overview: Peter runs against Lois for a seat on the school board.

episodes.name: A Picture Is Worth a 1,000 Bucks
episodes.overview: Peter is envious of an old friend's success; Chris' painting gets serious attention.

episodes.name: Fifteen Minutes of Shame
episodes.overview: Meg exposes her family on a talk show.

episodes.name: Road to Rhode Island
episodes.overview: Stewie misbehaves while visiting his grandparents.

episodes.name: Let's Go to the Hop
episodes.overview: Peter infiltrates Quahog High School as a new student.

episodes.name: Dammit Janet
episodes.overview: Lois enrolls Stewie at a day care center.

episodes.name: There's Something About Paulie
episodes.overview: As a favor, Peter takes a mobster's nephew to a movie.

episodes.name: He's Too Sexy for His Fat
episodes.overview: Peter talks himself into getting liposuction and other plastic surgery.

episodes.name: E. Peterbus Unum
episodes.overview: After learning that his property is not officially part of the United States, Peter forms his own country.

episodes.name: The Story on Page One
episodes.overview: Meg writes for the school paper to improve her Ivy League chances.

episodes.name: Wasted Talent
episodes.overview: Peter and his friends go on a drinking binge to find a winning ticket in a bottle; Lois works Ling too hard for a competition.

episodes.name: Fore Father
episodes.overview: Chris gets a job picking up golf balls; Peter ignores Chris in favor of Cleveland Jr.
